passages.sermon: David prayed to God.\r\nDavid spoke these words to God.\r\nDavid asked God for help.

passages.text: Incline Your ear, O LORD, and answer me, for I am poor and needy.
passages.sermon:
David prays to the LORD.
David asks God to listen to him.
David asks God to answer him.
David says he is poor.
David says he is needy.
passages.original: תְּפִלָּ֗ה לְדָ֫וִ֥ד הַטֵּֽה־ יְהוָ֣ה אָזְנְךָ֣ עֲנֵ֑נִי כִּֽי־ עָנִ֖י וְאֶבְי֣וֹן אָֽנִי׃

passages.text: Preserve my soul, for I am godly. You are my God; save Your servant who trusts in You.
passages.sermon:
David prays to God.
David asks God to keep his soul safe.
David says he is godly.
David calls himself God's servant.
David says God is his God.
David asks God to save him.
David says he trusts in God.
passages.original: שָֽׁמְרָ֣ה נַפְשִׁי֮ כִּֽי־ חָסִ֪יד אָ֥נִי הוֹשַׁ֣ע עַ֭בְדְּךָ אַתָּ֣ה אֱלֹהַ֑י הַבּוֹטֵ֥חַ אֵלֶֽיךָ׃

passages.text: Be merciful to me, O Lord, for I call to You all day long.
passages.sermon:
O Lord, I ask for Your mercy.
I call to You all day long.
I turn to You without stopping.
You are the one I seek for help.
I depend on Your kindness.
passages.original: חָנֵּ֥נִי אֲדֹנָ֑י כִּ֥י אֵלֶ֥יךָ אֶ֝קְרָ֗א כָּל־ הַיּֽוֹם׃

passages.text: Bring joy to Your servant, for to You, O Lord, I lift up my soul.
passages.sermon: I am your servant.\r\nI ask you to bring joy to my soul.\r\nO Lord, I lift up my soul to you.
passages.original: שַׂ֭מֵּחַ נֶ֣פֶשׁ עַבְדֶּ֑ךָ כִּ֥י אֵלֶ֥יךָ אֲ֝דֹנָ֗י נַפְשִׁ֥י אֶשָּֽׂא׃

passages.text: For You, O Lord, are kind and forgiving, rich in loving devotion to all who call on You.
passages.sermon:
O Lord, You are kind.
You forgive.
You show great love.
You give this love to everyone who calls on You.
passages.original: כִּֽי־ אַתָּ֣ה אֲ֭דֹנָי ט֣וֹב וְסַלָּ֑ח וְרַב־ חֶ֝֗סֶד לְכָל־ קֹרְאֶֽיךָ׃

passages.text: Hear my prayer, O LORD, and attend to my plea for mercy.
passages.sermon:
O LORD, I pray to You.
I ask You to listen to my prayer.
I ask You to hear my voice.
I plead for Your mercy.
I want You to pay attention to my request.
passages.original: הַאֲזִ֣ינָה יְ֭הוָה תְּפִלָּתִ֑י וְ֝הַקְשִׁ֗יבָה בְּק֣וֹל תַּחֲנוּנוֹתָֽי׃

passages.text: In the day of my distress I call on You, because You answer me.
passages.sermon:
The speaker is in distress.
The speaker calls on the Lord in that time.
The Lord answers the speaker.
The Lord responds when called upon in distress.

passages.text: O Lord, there is none like You among the gods, nor any works like Yours.
passages.sermon:
O Lord, You are unique among all gods.
No other god is like You.
No one can do works like Yours.
Your deeds are unmatched.
You alone stand above all others.
passages.original: אֵין־ כָּמ֖וֹךָ בָאֱלֹהִ֥ים׀ אֲדֹנָ֗י וְאֵ֣ין כְּֽמַעֲשֶֽׂיךָ׃

passages.text: All the nations You have made will come and bow before You, O Lord, and they will glorify Your name.
passages.sermon:
God made all nations.
All nations will come before God.
All nations will bow before God.
God is the Lord.
All nations will glorify God's name.
passages.original: כָּל־ גּוֹיִ֤ם׀ אֲשֶׁ֥ר עָשִׂ֗יתָ יָב֤וֹאוּ׀ וְיִשְׁתַּחֲו֣וּ לְפָנֶ֣יךָ אֲדֹנָ֑י וִֽיכַבְּד֣וּ לִשְׁמֶֽךָ׃

passages.text: For You are great and perform wonders; You alone are God.
passages.sermon: God is great.\r\nGod performs wonders.\r\nGod alone is God.
passages.original: כִּֽי־ גָד֣וֹל אַ֭תָּה וְעֹשֵׂ֣ה נִפְלָא֑וֹת אַתָּ֖ה אֱלֹהִ֣ים לְבַדֶּֽךָ׃

passages.text: Teach me Your way, O LORD, that I may walk in Your truth. Give me an undivided heart, that I may fear Your name.
passages.sermon:
O LORD, You are God.
You are the one I call to for help.
Teach me Your way.
Show me what You want me to do.
I want to walk in Your truth.
I want to live by what is right.
Give me an undivided heart.
Make my heart whole and true to You.
Help me fear Your name.
Let me honor and respect You always.
passages.original: ה֘וֹרֵ֤נִי יְהוָ֨ה׀ דַּרְכֶּ֗ךָ אֲהַלֵּ֥ךְ בַּאֲמִתֶּ֑ךָ יַחֵ֥ד לְ֝בָבִ֗י לְיִרְאָ֥ה שְׁמֶֽךָ׃

passages.text: I will praise You, O Lord my God, with all my heart; I will glorify Your name forever.
passages.sermon:
O Lord, You are my God.
I will praise You.
I will praise You with all my heart.
I will honor Your name.
I will honor Your name forever.
passages.original: אוֹדְךָ֤׀ אֲדֹנָ֣י אֱ֭לֹהַי בְּכָל־ לְבָבִ֑י וַאֲכַבְּדָ֖ה שִׁמְךָ֣ לְעוֹלָֽם׃

passages.text: For great is Your loving devotion to me; You have delivered me from the depths of Sheol.
passages.sermon: God shows me great loving devotion.\r\nGod delivers me from the depths of Sheol.\r\nGod saves my life from the grave.
passages.original: כִּֽי־ חַ֭סְדְּךָ גָּד֣וֹל עָלָ֑י וְהִצַּ֥לְתָּ נַ֝פְשִׁ֗י מִשְּׁא֥וֹל תַּחְתִּיָּֽה׃

passages.text: The arrogant rise against me, O God; a band of ruthless men seeks my life, with no regard for You.
passages.sermon:
God, arrogant people rise against me.
A group of ruthless men seeks my life.
They do not care about You.
They do not keep You before them.
passages.original: אֱלֹהִ֤ים׀ זֵ֘דִ֤ים קָֽמוּ־ עָלַ֗י וַעֲדַ֣ת עָ֭רִיצִים בִּקְשׁ֣וּ נַפְשִׁ֑י וְלֹ֖א שָׂמ֣וּךָ לְנֶגְדָּֽם׃

passages.text: But You, O Lord, are a compassionate and gracious God, slow to anger, abounding in loving devotion and faithfulness.
passages.sermon:
The Lord is God.
God is compassionate.
God is gracious.
God is slow to anger.
God abounds in loving devotion.
God abounds in faithfulness.
passages.original: וְאַתָּ֣ה אֲ֭דֹנָי אֵל־ רַח֣וּם וְחַנּ֑וּן אֶ֥רֶךְ אַ֝פַּ֗יִם וְרַב־ חֶ֥סֶד וֶאֱמֶֽת׃

passages.text: Turn to me and have mercy; grant Your strength to Your servant; save the son of Your maidservant.
passages.sermon:
God, I am Your servant.
I am the son of Your maidservant.
Turn to me.
Show me mercy.
Give me Your strength.
Save me.
passages.original: פְּנֵ֥ה אֵלַ֗י וְחָ֫נֵּ֥נִי תְּנָֽה־ עֻזְּךָ֥ לְעַבְדֶּ֑ךָ וְ֝הוֹשִׁ֗יעָה לְבֶן־ אֲמָתֶֽךָ׃

passages.text: Show me a sign of Your goodness, that my enemies may see and be ashamed; for You, O LORD, have helped me and comforted me.
passages.sermon:
The speaker addresses the LORD.
The LORD is compassionate and gracious.
The speaker asks the LORD to show a sign of goodness.
The speaker wants this sign to be clear.
The speaker wants enemies to see the sign.
The speaker wants enemies to feel ashamed.
The speaker says the LORD has helped him.
The speaker says the LORD has comforted him.
passages.original: עֲשֵֽׂה־ עִמִּ֥י א֗וֹת לְט֫וֹבָ֥ה וְיִרְא֣וּ שֹׂנְאַ֣י וְיֵבֹ֑שׁוּ כִּֽי־ אַתָּ֥ה יְ֝הוָ֗ה עֲזַרְתַּ֥נִי וְנִחַמְתָּֽנִי׃
